It is completely understandable to feel hesitant about how your supervisor might react, especially when you are already navigating a lot of personal stress. Since you mentioned that your supervisor has been making things difficult in the past and that a recent performance review impacted your confidence, it makes sense that this conversation feels daunting.

To help you prepare, would you like to talk through some specific points you want to make, or perhaps brainstorm a way to frame the request so it focuses on your productivity and success in your new role?
